desc: Prove that replacing the original graph with an MST preserves every bottleneck value \(f(x,y)\).

Derive and justify the DSU merge invariant: all possible pairs with bottleneck below the current edge weight have already been matched optimally, and each component can be represented by its net unmatched A/B balance.
Implement Kruskal to construct/process MST edges in nondecreasing weight order.
Implement DSU component metadata for counts of unmatched A occurrences and B occurrences, including repeated vertices.
At every successful DSU union, charge the correct number of newly matched pairs at that edge weight and consolidate the residual net balance.
Check 64-bit bounds and produce a Python implementation using integer arithmetic.
